summary: Japan Bank for International Cooperation filed a 424B5 final prospectus supplement for €1.5bn of 4.000% guaranteed bonds due October 7, 2033, unconditionally guaranteed by Japan. Price to public 99.946%, underwriting discount 0.150%, proceeds before expenses €1,496.94m; interest payable annually from October 7, 2027. Bonds in registered form, denominations €100,000 plus €1,000 multiples, listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange Euro MTF. Managers: Daiwa, Barclays, Crédit Agricole CIB, J.P. Morgan. This is a routine sovereign-guaranteed debt takedown, not a special situation.
